heading: Add the SYLY assistant to your site
intro: Choose the options, check the live preview, then copy two lines into your page before </body>. No account and no login: nothing you choose here is stored.
theme_auto: Auto: use my site's --bs-primary if it is readable
colourOk: Contrast with white text: {ratio} to 1. Readable.
colourBad: Contrast with white text is only {ratio} to 1. It must be at least 4.5 to 1, so this colour is not used. Choose a darker colour.
colourInvalid: Write the colour as # and six letters or numbers, for example #002B56.
mode_panel: Panel: a button on the side of the page opens the assistant
mode_inline: Inline: an ask box inside your page content
apiHint: Leave empty to use only keyword search in the browser.
providerNote: The AI provider is not set here: it is chosen on your server in the .env file (PROVIDER=cloud, local or none). With none, the assistant still answers from your content.
previewHint: This is the real assistant with your options. In panel mode, its button is on the side of this page.
codeHint: Paste these lines before </body> on every page that should have the assistant.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it by hand.
eventsHeading: Events your page can listen to
eventsIntro: The assistant never changes your page. It tells you what happened with these events:
event_question: a learner asked a question: {text, language}
event_escalated: a learner asked for a person: {ticketId}
linkReadme: README: install, run and every API call
linkDocs: API documentation (Swagger UI) on your server: /docs
footTagline: Answers from the course, in the learner's language, with a person one button away.
footTeam: Team SYLY: Lemi, Saron, Yabets, Yamlak
